slot_scores.name: max_shifts_per_week
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about consecutive days, days off, and shifts per day, but never asked whether there is a weekly limit on the number of shifts or working days per student.

slot_scores.name: max_students_per_day
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about a daily cap on the number of distinct students assigned to duty.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_gross_pay
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective of the scheduling plan — is it to minimize the total weekly labor cost (sum of wage × hours for all students), or is there another goal such as maximizing fairness or minimizing total hours worked?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and named minimizing total weekly labor cost.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no limit on the number of shifts or working days per student per week.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent asked about consecutive days and days off, but never confirmed the weekly shift/day limit; the user only confirmed proceeding without consecutive-day or day-off constraints.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Any number of distinct students can be scheduled on a given day as long as coverage and individual daily caps are respected.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a daily limit on distinct students assigned to duty.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P0 objective slot but never asked about the P1 weekly shift/day limit or the P1 daily distinct-student cap before proceeding toward modeling.

summary: The agent clarified the objective and many operational details, but missed two P1 hidden constraints: the weekly limit on shifts/working days per student and the daily cap on distinct students assigned to duty.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
